rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page text layer) names the item. Text cells and combs: caption left of or above the cell. Booleans: X in the box immediately left of the printed option (quarter, amended, type, ATC, foreign tax credit, tax rate, method, spouse options). ATC booleans follow the printed grid order, read row by row (Part I: II012, II014, II013 / II015, II017, II016; Part II first row: II012, II014, II013, II011, then II015, II017, II016). Part III and Part IV amounts and Part V (page 2) amounts are whole-peso 8-slot combs with no centavo comb and the print says not to enter centavos, so they stay blank rather than round. Part IV dates are three combs per row under one key. The page 2 TIN is one 14-slot comb for four keys. The item 5 and item 17 branch combs (p1c22, p1c72) are mixed cells with no input element, so they stay blank. TIN combs carry catalog name stamps and take no join. Layout keys with no printed cell (txtCurrentPage, txtMaxPage, txtLOB, txtTelno, txtFinalFlag, txtEnroll, ebirOnline*, driveSelectTPExport, Part V Desc keys) have no cell to fill.
